items.source: Publishes the given message to the given channel.
items.translation: 将给定的 `message` 发布到给定的 `channel`。

items.source: Publishes the given messages to the appropriate channels.
items.translation: 将给定的消息发布到适当的通道。

items.source: Creates a subscription for this connection. Connections can have multiple ReactiveSubscriptions.
items.translation: 为此连接创建一个订阅。一个连接可以有多个ReactiveSubscription。

items.source: Creates a subscription for this connection.
items.translation: 为此连接创建订阅。

items.source: the subscription.
items.translation: 订阅。

items.source: the number of clients that received the message.
items.translation: 收到该消息的客户端数量。

items.source: Note that cancellation of the Flux will unsubscribe from channels.
items.translation: 请注意，取消订阅 `Flux` 将从 `channels` 中取消订阅。

items.source: Note that cancellation of the Flux will unsubscribe from patterns.
items.translation: 请注意，取消订阅 `Flux` 将从 `patterns` 中取消订阅。

items.source: Use createSubscription(SubscriptionListener) to get notified when the subscription completes.
items.translation: 使用createSubscription(SubscriptionListener)来接收订阅完成时的通知。

items.source: Redis Pub/Sub commands executed using reactive infrastructure.
items.translation: 使用响应式基础设施执行的 Redis 发布/订阅 命令。

items.source: Subscribes the connection to all channels matching the given patterns.
items.translation: 将连接订阅所有匹配给定 patterns 的频道。

items.source: Subscribes the connection to the given channels.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到给定的 `channels`。

items.source: • Redis Documentation: PSUBSCRIBE
items.translation: • Redis 文档：PSUBSCRIBE

items.source: subscriptionListener - the subscription listener to listen for subscription confirmations.
items.translation: subscriptionListener - 用于监听订阅确认的订阅监听器。

items.source: channel - the channel to publish to. Must not be null.
items.translation: channel - 要发布到的通道。不能为 null。

items.source: message - message to publish. Must not be null.
items.translation: message - 要发布的信息。不能为 null。

items.source: messageStream - the messages to publish to. Must not be null.
items.translation: messageStream - 要发布消息的目标。不能为 null。

items.source: channels - channel names, must not be null.
items.translation: channels - 频道名称，不能为 null。

items.source: patterns - channel name patterns, must not be null.
items.translation: <patterns> - 频道名称模式，不能为 null。

items.source: Mark Paluch, Christoph Strobl
items.translation: Mark Paluch，Christoph Strobl

items.source: Subscribes the connection to the given channels. Once subscribed, a connection enters listening mode and can only subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到给定的 `channels`。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时只能订阅其他频道或取消订阅。在取消订阅之前，不接受任何其他命令。

items.source: Subscribes the connection to all channels matching the given patterns. Once subscribed, a connection enters listening mode and can only subscribe to other channels or unsubscribe. No other commands are accepted until the connection is unsubscribed.
items.translation: 将连接订阅到所有匹配给定 `patterns` 的频道。一旦订阅成功，连接即进入监听模式，此时只能订阅其他频道或取消订阅，直到连接被取消订阅之前，不接受任何其他命令。
